title: Orientation
description: auto picks from the page's shape: a tall box gets the data column (ratio, accuracy, bar, six counts with shares, combo and KPS), a box at least twice as wide as tall gets the compact focus row (ratio, six counts, accuracy, KPS) meant to sit centred over the stage just above the receptors.

title: Alignment
description: auto = left for the column, centre for the row. right mirrors the column (colour marks on the right) so it can sit left of the stage; for the row it packs the content to that side of the box.

title: Backing
description: none floats on the game with a light text shadow; scrim adds a soft dark fade behind the numbers; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Accent colour
description: map tints the live dot and the ratio's :1 with the current map's tonal colour; 18-lab keeps amber. Judgement colours never change.

title: Show MAX:300 ratio
description: MAX (320) judgements per 300, to two decimals; ∞ until the first 300. Also shown on the results screen, which osu! does not.

title: Show keys per second
description: Presses in the last second and the attempt's peak, counted from vosu's keys.all. The results screen keeps the peak of the attempt you just played.
